candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement updating pastBlockTime, so the public getter returns a stale value after the first call.
Replace the update with pastBlockTime = block.timestamp, so the getter returns timestamp instead of timestamp+1.
Delete the timestamp guard require so multiple calls in the same block are allowed and pastBlockTime can be updated again.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether); statement so any value is accepted.
Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime); statement so repeated calls in the same block are allowed.
Replace the pastBlockTime update with pastBlockTime = block.timestamp; so calls in consecutive blocks are rejected.
Invert the payout condition to block.number % 15 != 0 so payouts occur on different blocks.
Delete the entire payout if-statement so the contract never transfers its balance.
Remove the check that exactly 10 ether is sent, so calls with any value now proceed.
Remove the one-call-per-block-time check so repeated calls at the same timestamp are allowed.
Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp instead of block.timestamp + 1, changing the recorded value.
Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 to block.number % 7 so transfers occur on different blocks.
Transfer a fixed 1 ether instead of the whole contract balance on payout blocks.
Move the pastBlockTime update after the payout if-block, so a reverting transfer leaves pastBlockTime unupdated.
